nina: quick idea: let node sidecars propose local fallback requests when they see signals (p99 latency, KV miss spike).
omar: this is tempting for latency, but auditability is a must. how do we trace origin?
priya: require a decision_id on every request. sidecar emits a tiny event to decisions.request and includes cert thumbprint.
cal: UI: operator inbox card = time / service / requester / short reason / confidence. expand -> 30s signal window + link to playback. keep it condensed.
nina: rollout policy toggle: 'permit node fallback requests' with threshold + cooldown + notify level. default OFF for prod tenants.
omar: avoid flip-flop: local requests are advisory; central arbiter applies final decision. console shows "requested by X, applied by Y".
priya: plan: sidecar -> kafka decisions.request; arbiter -> decisions.response {accepted|rejected|deferred}. tag traces with decision_id.
cal: operator override needs TTL + required annotation. audit retention 90d exportable.
ops-bot: infra note: sidecar metrics indexed as sidecar.* but no decision_id yet.
nina: pilot: feature-flagged metrics-only mode first (emit requests but do not apply). if telemetry looks good, enable tiny pool.
omar: security: mTLS + per-node signer tokens, audit cert thumbprint.
priya: action items: runtime add decision_id header (owner: priya, EOW), platform design arbiter + schema (owner: omar, next Wed), ux mock inbox + timeline (owner: cal, Tue).
nina: will draft RFC + pilot plan. thanks. :raised_hands:
ops-bot: NOTE: created INFRA-1310 for sidecar fallback pilot."
